# Jeremiah 2 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** And-came [the]-word-of YHWH to-me, saying:

**2** "Go and-call in-[the]-ears-of Jerusalem, saying, 'Thus says YHWH: I-remember for-you the-lovingkindness-of your-youth, the-love-of your-bridal-days, your-going after-Me in-the-wilderness, in-a-land not sown.

**3** Holy [was] Israel to-YHWH, [the]-firstfruits-of His-harvest; all eating-him were-held-guilty — evil came upon-them,'" declares YHWH.

**4** Hear [the]-word-of YHWH, house-of Jacob, and-all [the]-families-of [the]-house-of Israel.

**5** Thus says YHWH: "What injustice did your-fathers find in-Me, that they-went-far from-upon-Me and-went after the-vanity and-became-vain?

**6** And-they-did-not-say, 'Where [is] YHWH, the-One-bringing-us-up from-[the]-land-of Egypt, the-One-leading-us in-the-wilderness, in-a-land-of desert and-pit, in-a-land-of drought and-deep-darkness, in-a-land not passed-through and-no man dwelt there?'

**7** And-I-brought-you to a-land-of [the]-garden to-eat its-fruit and-its-goodness, and-you-came and-defiled My-land, and-My-inheritance you-made an-abomination.

**8** The-priests did-not-say, 'Where [is] YHWH?' And-[the]-handlers-of [the]-law did-not-know-Me, and-the-shepherds transgressed against-Me, and-the-prophets prophesied by-Baal and-after things-not-profiting they-went.

**9** Therefore still I-will-contend with-you," declares YHWH, "and-with [the]-sons-of your-sons I-will-contend.

**10** For cross to-[the]-coastlands-of Kittim and-see, and-to-Kedar send and-consider well, and-see if-there-has-been like-this:

**11** Has a-nation changed gods — and-they [are]-no gods? But-My-people has-changed its-glory for-what-does-not-profit.

**12** Be-appalled, O-heavens, at-this, and-shudder, be-utterly-desolate," declares YHWH,

**13** "For two evils My-people has-done: Me they-have-forsaken, [the]-fountain-of waters living, to-hew for-themselves cisterns, cisterns broken, which cannot hold the-waters.

**14** Is Israel a-slave? Or a-home-born-[servant] is-he? Why has-he-become plunder?

**15** Against-him young-lions roar; they-give their-voice, and-they-make his-land a-desolation; his-cities are-burned without inhabitant.

**16** Also [the]-sons-of Noph and-Tahpanhes graze-upon your-scalp.

**17** Has-not-this your-forsaking YHWH your-God done to-you, at-[the]-time He-led-you in-the-way?

**18** And-now, what [is it]-to-you [on the]-way-to Egypt to-drink [the]-waters-of Shihor? And-what [is it]-to-you [on the]-way-to Assyria to-drink [the]-waters-of [the]-River?

**19** Your-evil will-discipline-you, and-your-apostasies will-rebuke-you; and-know and-see that evil and-bitter [is] your-forsaking YHWH your-God, and-My-dread [is]-not upon-you," declares the-Lord YHWH-of hosts.

**20** For from-long-ago you-broke your-yoke, you-tore-apart your-bonds, and-you-said, 'I-will-not-serve.' For upon every hill high and-under every tree luxuriant you-were-lying-down [as]-a-prostitute.

**21** And-I planted-you a-choice-vine, entirely a-seed-of truth; and-how have-you-turned to-Me [into]-degenerate-shoots-of a-vine foreign?

**22** For though you-wash with-natron and-multiply for-yourself soap, stained [is] your-iniquity before-Me," declares the-Lord YHWH.

**23** "How can-you-say, 'I-am-not-defiled; after the-Baals I-have-not-gone'? See your-way in-the-valley; know what you-have-done — a-young-camel swift interlacing her-ways,

**24** A-wild-donkey accustomed-to [the]-wilderness, in-[the]-desire-of her-soul she-snuffs [the]-wind; her-heat — who can-turn-her-back? All seeking-her will-not-weary-themselves; in-her-month they-will-find-her.

**25** Withhold your-foot from-bareness and-your-throat from-thirst. But-you-said, 'It-is-hopeless! No! For I-have-loved strangers and-after-them I-will-go.'

**26** As-[the]-shame-of a-thief when-he-is-found, so are-put-to-shame [the]-house-of Israel — they, their-kings, their-princes, and-their-priests, and-their-prophets —

**27** Saying to-a-tree, 'My-father you [are],' and-to-a-stone, 'You bore-me.' For they-turned to-Me [the]-back and-not [the]-face, but-in-[the]-time-of their-evil they-say, 'Arise and-save-us!'

**28** And-where [are] your-gods which you-made for-yourself? Let-them-arise if they-can-save-you in-[the]-time-of your-evil; for [as the]-number-of your-cities are your-gods, Judah.

**29** Why do-you-contend against-Me? All-of-you have-transgressed against-Me," declares YHWH.

**30** In-vain I-struck your-sons; discipline they-did-not-receive. Your-sword devoured your-prophets like-a-lion destroying.

**31** O-generation, see [the]-word-of YHWH! Have-I-been a-wilderness to-Israel, or-a-land-of thick-darkness? Why do-My-people say, 'We-roam-free; we-will-not-come to-You again'?

**32** Does a-maiden forget her-ornaments, or-a-bride her-sashes? But-My-people have-forgotten-Me — days without number.

**33** How you-make-good your-way to-seek love! Therefore even the-wicked-women you-have-taught your-ways.

**34** Also on-your-skirts is-found [the]-blood-of [the]-souls-of [the]-poor innocents; not in-breaking-in I-found-them, but upon all these.

**35** And-you-say, 'Indeed I-am-innocent; surely His-anger has-turned from-me.' Behold-Me entering-into-judgment with-you upon your-saying, 'I-have-not-sinned.'

**36** Why do-you-go-about so-much to-change your-way? Also from-Egypt you-will-be-put-to-shame, as you-were-put-to-shame from-Assyria.

**37** Also from-this you-will-go-out, and-your-hands [upon] your-head; for YHWH has-rejected your-confidences, and-you-will-not-prosper by-them.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **2:2**: Chesed ne'uraikh — 'lovingkindness of your youth.' YHWH remembers Israel's 'honeymoon period' — the wilderness wandering as a time of intimacy.

- **2:13**: Me'qor mayim chayyim — 'fountain of living waters.' The central metaphor: YHWH as inexhaustible source vs. broken cisterns of human substitutes.

- **2:23-24**: Wild camel and wild donkey imagery — startlingly vivid sexual metaphors for Israel's uncontrollable pursuit of foreign gods.

— EMET
